push.title: W 3-0 vs Paris Saint Bal | You: 7.0 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
A 7.0, buddskees, your 2nd best match performance. Little rusty, easy to polish.

DID WELL
+ A goal against Paris Saint Bal. Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag.
+ Man of the Match. Man of the Match: the highest compliment the game gives out.
+ A 7.0, your 2nd best match performance. You're raising your own bar.
+ 3-0 over Paris Saint Bal. Points banked, smiles earned.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. Real talk: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal. It's coming.
- 67% passing (2 of 3). Old coach's advice: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. Water the plant.
- Rating came in 0.7 below what your on-ball stats earned. Mark my words: Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.
- You and BellyTb1 share the defensive work rate homework. Study group: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Key passes: 0. A few steps from the 2+ club.

Practice plan: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

buddskees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Every game teaches us something. - Coach Lasso
